comment: check_dfm fab profile template: fill in YOUR fabricator's published numbers.
Save it in the project folder (next to the .PrjPcb) as fab_profile.json to use it by default, or as <name>.json and pass profile='<name>'.
Every limit below is null until you fill it in; a limit left null (or deleted) is not checked.

Lengths end in _mm or _mil (min_trace_mm or min_trace_mil, not both); ratios, percentages and counts take no suffix. Board sizes are a number or [a, b] either way round; layer_counts is a list of copper layer counts.

_specific_limits lists the limits that fall back to a generic one: to set one, add its key to limits with a number. Leave it out to use the generic limit; null would stop the fallback and leave it unchecked.
based_on is left out, so nothing is inherited. Add "based_on": "altimade" only if your fab's table matches Altimade's for every limit you leave out.
name: My fab, standard class
source: URL or document of the fab's capability table
source_updated: date or revision of that table

_notes.min_route_size_mm: the narrowest routed slot; a narrower slot is info
_notes.drill_allowance_mm: drilled = finished hole + allowance, for a second aspect ratio
_notes.tolerance_percent: a miss within this percentage of a limit is marginal (default 2)
_notes.copper_oz: the heaviest copper weight the fab offers, in oz
